pre_data: Claims, the two counters and the shared counter library freeze before any claim artifact lands. Every constant is read with `git show <freeze>:reports/round-84/claims.json`, never from the graded tree. Each counter refuses (exit 2, `FAIL legs=0/<n> (refused: ...)`) a revision that is not 40-hex, a freeze that is not an ancestor of lands, lands equal to the frozen base (the do-nothing control), unreadable or incomplete frozen config, a leg list that disagrees with its own leg table, a lands revision that is not an ancestor of the branch tip, and a --work that is not an existing directory. Claim verdicts are graded on committed bytes only: each counter materialises the blobs it grades from --root:<rev> into <work>/tree before running anything, and runs the materialised tools, never the worktree copies.

claims.title: Land tools/apply-sound-laws.py — a deterministic, dependency-free applier for ordered sound laws over a segment-tokenised proto-lexicon, with one trace line per change, a committed example (12 words, >= 6 ordered rules) that the tool reproduces byte-for-byte, and its SKILL.md `## Gates and probes` row

do_nothing_control: At --lands = the frozen base every counter refuses with exit 2 (`FAIL legs=0/<n> (refused: lands equals the frozen base -- do-nothing control)`): a control that lands nothing cannot commit an entry, open a source row, acquire the tool or add its registry row.
